title: NotebookEdit into a protected place is denied by its notebook_path
source: intended: docs/decisions.md A5 (defect N-25): the guard denies writes into builds, jitso/jitso.yaml and the hard rules
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-25, owner answer A5). NotebookEdit names its file in notebook_path, not file_path. The guard reads that field and denies a notebook inside jitso/builds/. The TS binary judges only Bash and orca MCP tools, and its Bash rules do not know these writes, so it prints nothing and the decision FAILS on TS.

reason.regex: ^JITSO: only the owner changes approved builds, jitso/jitso\.yaml and the hard rules; draft a build with (bun run jitso|jitso) build draft and ask the owner to save it \(denied: [A-Za-z -]+ jitso/(builds/|hard-rules/|jitso\.yaml)?\)$
